title: Corrected transcript — Whisper heard '4.5%', the surveyor corrected it to '45%'
why: The transcript record is status 'corrected' with the surveyor's text. Only the corrected text reaches the pipeline. The finding must carry 45, not 4.5, and the reading-dependent reasoning must follow the corrected figure (a 45% reading does not read as condensation-only).
